card.name: Inside all-caps warning terms
card.fires_on: Partway through an all-caps boxed-warning term such as RESPIRATORY, PULMONARY or LIVER, and on linking words like "including" or "of" just before a capitalized risk name.

modes.label: Inside capitalized organ words
modes.description: The middle or end of an organ-related adjective or noun in capitals, before a reaction or injury word.
modes.example: ACUTE RESPIR<<ATORY>> COMPLICATIONS ASSOCIATED WITH ADMIN

modes.label: Linking word before a risk name
modes.description: "including" or "of" right before a capitalized syndrome or toxicity name.
modes.example: NEUROLOGIC TOXICITY,<< including>> IMMUNE EFFECTOR CELL-ASSOCI

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward short capital-letter abbreviation-like pieces and away from other capitalized word starts.
card.plain: It fires inside capitalized warning words, like the middle of RESPIRATORY or LIVER, in boxed warnings.
